title: MAI Realtime 1 is a preview. The minute price is not the whole bill.
friendlyTitle: Microsoft's new voice model is a preview. The minute price is not the whole bill.
summary: Microsoft introduced MAI Realtime 1, a speech-to-speech model priced at $0.01 per audio minute, with reasoning billed separately at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens. You can try it in MAI Labs or register for a limited Foundry preview. Preview customers are not billed until the public preview begins.
friendlySummary: Microsoft introduced MAI Realtime 1, a model that listens and speaks. The audio price is $0.01 a minute. Extra reasoning is billed separately, at $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens. You can try it in MAI Labs, or ask for a limited preview. Preview users are not billed until the public preview starts.
whyItMatters: Microsoft says it is bringing the model to Dynamics 365 Contact Center and to Dragon Copilot for practice conversations with nurses. Those product claims, and the benchmark comparisons, are Microsoft's. A voice agent can take the routine call. A person still has to take the exception.
